title: Refund Bases, Windows and Storm Credit Terms for Lift Tickets
content:
The finance terms of the Lift Tickets line fall into two schedules: what a product returns when an order is given back or abandoned, and what it credits when a day is lost to the mountain.

## Schedule A — return terms

| Product | Refund basis | Refund window | Refund fee | Abandonment fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | no refund | 0 days | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | no refund | 0 days | USD 0.00 | USD 10.00 |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | unused days pro rata | 7 days | USD 20.00 | USD 10.00 |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | unused days pro rata | 14 days | USD 25.00 | USD 15.00 |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | unused days pro rata | 14 days | USD 25.00 | USD 15.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | full price paid | 30 days | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |

The refund basis is how a refund on the product is worked out, and is one of the full price paid, the unused days pro rata, or no refund. The refund window is the number of calendar days after the order is recorded within which a refund may be asked for. The refund fee is the amount retained from a refund on the product. The abandonment fee is the amount retained when an unpaid order is abandoned.

## Schedule B — storm credit terms

| Product | Day lost to lift closures credited back | Share of the mountain's lifts that must be closed | Share of the day's price credited | Credit validity | Smallest amount applied to one charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | no | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 days | USD 0.00 |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | no | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 days | USD 0.00 |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | yes | 50 percent | 50 percent | 180 days | USD 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | yes | 50 percent | 75 percent | 270 days | USD 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | yes | 40 percent | 100 percent | 270 days | USD 25.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | yes | 30 percent | 100 percent | 365 days | USD 50.00 |

The third column is the percentage of the mountain's lifts that must be closed for a day to count as lost to the mountain. The fourth is the percentage of the day's price credited back where a day is lost to the mountain. The credit validity is the number of calendar days from issue within which ticket credit must be spent, and the last column is the smallest amount of ticket credit that may be applied to a single charge.
